children: Is your home ready for an EV?
Most homes can charge an electric car overnight — but only if the panel has room and the charger is wired to match your vehicle. Guess wrong and you get slow charging or a tripped breaker.

Our EV consult settles it in one visit: we check your panel’s spare capacity, measure the cable run to where you park, and quote a charger that fits. If the panel needs a little work first, you’ll know before you spend a cent.

pages.name: About
pages.seoDescription: Who Voltline Electric is, what we do and the people behind the work.

children.class: mx-auto grid w-full max-w-5xl items-center gap-10 @3xl:grid-cols-2 @3xl:gap-16

attrs.alt: A modern home at dusk with an EV charging in the driveway

children: Voltline started with a simple frustration: too many homes and businesses were being wired for how things used to be, not for EVs, solar, batteries and everything now plugged into the wall. We built the kind of electrical company we wished we could hire.

We’re a small, certified crew that does the modern work well — chargers, panels, automation, solar tie-ins and commercial fit-outs — and we explain it in plain language, permits and inspections included. No jargon, no upsell, no surprises on the bill.

children.class: mx-auto flex w-full max-w-5xl flex-col gap-10

children: Every job starts with someone on-site looking at your actual panel and wiring — so the price you get is the price it costs.
We pull the permits and book the inspection as part of the job. You get work that’s done right and signed off, not a shortcut.
You’ll understand what we’re doing and why, and what it means for your rebates and your bill. Questions are welcome, always.
